# Qaam.pk

Qaam.pk is an online store for laptops, computers, tablets, projectors, parts, and accessories in Pakistan.

- [Shop](https://www.qaam.pk/shop)

- [About Qaam.pk](https://www.qaam.pk/about)
- [Contact](https://www.qaam.pk/contact)
- [Frequently asked questions](https://www.qaam.pk/faq)
